title: Skill-suite calibration — updated mikko- library
method: A/B token measurement, cold arm A (no skill) vs with-skill arm B, across Opus 4.8 / Sonnet 4.6 / Haiku 4.5. 8 skills x 2 arms x 3 models = 48 sub-agent arms. Tasks auto-synthesized, pinned targets. Single-agent approximation for orchestrators. Tokens = harness subagent_tokens (input + output + cache-creation). N=1 per cell. Read-only.

cells.note: skill pricier but more correct (cold mis-counted cache-read)
skill arm did a 453s/117-tool deep pass; cold arm lean
CONTAMINATED — skill arm reused a prior arm's report file; unreliable

cross_model_finding: Token savings scale inversely with model capability: aggregate +13% (Opus) -> +15% (Sonnet) -> +27% (Haiku). Weaker models scout cold less efficiently, so the skill's procedure/script wins more. 'audit' is monotonic: -51% -> +2% -> +7%.
durable_findings: Script-backed skills (skills-quality, skills-freshness, session-cost) save on every model — they carry the aggregate.
react-anti-patterns-audit is neutral on every model (+6/+6/-3%).
Big meta-skill saves are 'save by not looking' — short-circuit pre-pass/hash; cold arms caught real bloat/drift the skill arms missed.
Prose audits (ai-codegen, readme) are wash-to-negative vs a capable cold model, high N=1 variance.
Haiku is the least reliable arm (hallucinated finding, wrong 'tokens unavailable' conclusion, a PowerShell-deny-circumvention flag).
caveats: N=1 per cell — direction + rough magnitude only.
Auto-synthesized tasks + single-agent orchestrator approximation inflate audit/readme skill-arm cost.
Side-effect contamination: skill arms wrote reports later same-skill arms occasionally reused (ai-codegen Haiku-B).
Outcome != tokens — saves can hide misses; costs can carry better fidelity.
Total measurement cost ~2.54M subagent_tokens across 48 arms (Opus ~931K, Sonnet ~856K, Haiku ~751K).

after_remeasure.note: After claude-skills #24 optimized 3 skills, each optimized skill's with-skill arm (B) was re-measured on all 3 models, same tasks + accounting. Compares B(before-optim) -> B(after-optim). N=1 per cell.
after_remeasure.conclusion: Per-invocation token effect of the optimization is below the N=1 noise floor. Per-cell swings (-50% to +12%) are uncorrelated with the 1-3 KB SKILL.md body reduction; task-work variance (the same audit cost 56K-143K across runs) dwarfs it 20-60x. The -16% overall is the before pass's high outliers regressing to the mean, not a measured saving. The optimization's real payoff is the always-loaded description weight, context cleanliness, and correctness -- not per-invocation tokens.

spacepotatis_calibration.note: Second corpus: the 4 cleanly-A/B-able read-only Spacepotatis audit skills, measured cold (A) vs with the FINETUNED skill (B) across 3 models after the finetune (Spacepotatis #286). 8 generative scaffolders + 2 orchestrators were finetuned but excluded from A/B (they mutate the repo). 24 arms, subagent_tokens, N=1, read-only pinned targets. B arms read the finetuned SKILL.md from a worktree off the merged master; cold A arms are skill-independent and unchanged.
spacepotatis_calibration.remeasure_note: B column re-measured. A first pass accidentally read the pre-finetune skills (local checkout lagged the #286 merge): aggregate +6/+8/+7% (overall skill_total 856229). Re-running the same arms against the finetuned skills (near-identical content) gave +16/+14/+15% -- an ~8-point swing from two compounding noise sources, neither a finetune effect: the few-KB skill delta is far too small to move 8 points, and the cold A-arms were not re-run (so each cell now pairs a run-1 A against a run-2 B, adding cross-session drift on top of the per-cell N=1 variance) -- a direct confirmation of this doc's noise-floor thesis. Which skill saves vs washes is stable across both runs; only magnitudes wobble.
spacepotatis_calibration.finding: balance-review is the standout saver (+43/+58/+39%) -- structured metric procedure beats cold scouting. ai-codegen is wash-to-negative (-21/-9/-2%), same prose-audit pattern as the mikko- copy. content saves (+45/+28/+8%); save-roundtrip is mixed (-12/-30/+16%). Net is a flat ~+15% (+16/+14/+15%, not monotonic) because the corpus blends strong savers (balance, content) with washes (ai-codegen, save). Durable lesson reproduces across both repos: token savings concentrate in procedure/script-backed skills; prose audits wash against a capable cold model.

audiobookmaker_calibration.note: Third corpus: the 4 cleanly-A/B-able read-only AudiobookMaker skills (a Python desktop app), measured cold (A) vs with the FINETUNED skill (B) across 3 models. The other 6 skills (ci-failure-triage, pronunciation-corpus-add, release-cut, voice-pack-finnish, work-session, worktree-launch) were finetuned but excluded from A/B (they mutate the repo or need live inputs). 24 arms, subagent_tokens, N=1, read-only pinned targets: src/ tree (audit, ai-codegen), the PyInstaller .spec (release-bundle), a HEAD~3..HEAD diff (copyright-scan). copyright-scan was previously gitignored local-only; sanitized + tracked for this run.
audiobookmaker_calibration.finding: audit is the standout -- a clean monotonic saver (+13/+16/+25%); its 5-phase procedure caps the cold arm's scaling and it saves on every model. ai-codegen washes on Opus (~0%) but saves big on Sonnet/Haiku (+51/+32%) -- cold arms ran exhaustive 122K/71K audits while the skill short-circuited via its prior-audit calibration log. copyright-scan is wash-to-negative (-19/-53/-5%): the 7-check procedure on a tiny 2-file diff costs more than a cold scan. release-bundle is mixed (-16/+11/+18%). Net opus +1 / sonnet +24 / haiku +22 / overall +16%, but the per-model aggregates are not broad-based: sonnet's +24% is ~76% the single ai-codegen N=1 short-circuit cell (62.8K of 83K), opus is flat-by-offset (audit's +15.5K cancelled by copyright/release-bundle ~-12K), only haiku is broad (audit ~46%, ai-codegen ~41%). Read magnitudes as N=1; this corpus does NOT show the inverse-capability curve (it's non-monotonic). Arm-B skills were read from the unmerged local-only chore/skills-token-finetune branch (now PR #84; not yet reproducible from mainline, unlike the SP corpus vs merged #286 -- so this corpus is one evidence tier lower). What replicates 3/3 is the concentration thesis (procedure/script-backed skills save; prose washes); the inverse-capability curve replicates only 1/3 (mikko- only). See cross_corpus_synthesis.

thesis_1_concentration.claim: Savings concentrate in procedure/script-backed skills; prose audits wash against a capable cold model.
thesis_1_concentration.note: Holds in mikko- (script-backed skills-quality/freshness/session-cost save on every model), Spacepotatis (balance-review's metric procedure is the standout), and AudiobookMaker (audit's bounded multi-phase procedure saves across the board; copyright-scan's prose checks lose). Genuine external validity across three differently-shaped codebases.

thesis_2_inverse_capability.claim: Savings scale inversely with model capability (the inverse-capability curve).
thesis_2_inverse_capability.note: Clean only in mikko- (+13/+15/+27). Spacepotatis flat/non-monotonic (+16/+14/+15, opus highest); AudiobookMaker +1/+24/+22 (non-monotonic, aggregates rest on fragile single cells). Mechanism: the curve appears only where the cold arm's cost scales steeply as the model weakens -- a property of the task, not a law of skills. Must not ride on thesis 1's replication.

cross_corpus_synthesis.colour_threshold: Tables colour at +/-20%, not +/-10%, because the doc demonstrates its own noise floor: the SP re-measure swung ~8pp from pure cross-session drift (run-1 A vs run-2 B). Every A/B pair here was non-simultaneous, so ~8pp cross-session drift + N=1 task variance rides on every cell. Within +/-20% is direction-at-best, not coloured as signal (e.g. audit's +13/+16 render neutral).
cross_corpus_synthesis.contamination: A harness isolation bug, not a per-cell footnote: side-effect-file reuse + the PowerShell-via-Bash deny-flag trip recurred in all three runs (deny-flag hit Haiku twice). Arms are not isolated from each other's side effects; every report-writing-skill cell is potentially contaminated until the harness sandboxes arms. Fix before the next run.
cross_corpus_synthesis.evidence_tiers: mikko- and Spacepotatis measured against mainline-merged skills (SP #286); AudiobookMaker is one tier lower (arm-B skills from the unmerged PR #84 branch, not yet reproducible from mainline).
